facts.value: Funding is allocated on a first come basis.

Public Administration - Graduate Diploma or MA

facts.value: Identify the organisation you will visit and obtain permission from the organisation as well as your line manager. Discuss the type of activities you wish to undertake and create a programme of activities in collaboration with the host organisation.
facts.programme_association: Public Administration - Graduate Diploma or MA

facts.value: Complete the Staff Mobility agreement for Teaching or Training. Answer all questions in full and include a detailed programme of activities.
facts.programme_association: Public Administration - Graduate Diploma or MA

facts.value: The partner institution will sign your agreement, your line manager signs off on the quality of the agreement and grants permission to travel. Please do this at least 5 weeks prior to your intended travel date.
facts.programme_association: Public Administration - Graduate Diploma or MA

facts.value: Submit your fully signed mobility agreement to staff.mobility@ul.ie and UL Global will sign the agreement regarding the administrative requirements.
facts.programme_association: Public Administration - Graduate Diploma or MA

facts.value: Allow 10 working days for your contract to be issued.
facts.programme_association: Public Administration - Graduate Diploma or MA

facts.value: 80% of your grant payment will be made within 30 calendar days after the signature of the agreement by both parties.
facts.programme_association: Public Administration - Graduate Diploma or MA

facts.value: Keep your boarding cards and submit copies of these along with a signed and stamped Certificate of Attendance from your host to staff.mobility@ul.ie within 10 days of your return from teaching/training.
facts.programme_association: Public Administration - Graduate Diploma or MA

facts.value: Complete the final report which you will receive via email from a Europa.eu email address.
facts.programme_association: Public Administration - Graduate Diploma or MA

facts.value: Your final grant payment will be made within 10 working days on receipt of all documentation.
facts.programme_association: Public Administration - Graduate Diploma or MA

facts.value: Once your final grant payment is made, you must complete the Acknowledgement of Grant Receipt form and return the completed form to staff.mobility@ul.ie.
facts.programme_association: Public Administration - Graduate Diploma or MA

facts.value: Check out the process map by downloading it [here](https://www.ul.ie/media/33354/download?inline).
